title: map_central_sulcus
description: Performs all, or any part of, the FreeSurfer cortical reconstruction process.

subjid.description: FreeSurfer subject identification string which doubles as the name of the reconstruction root directory for the subject.
subjid.title: Subject ID

hemi_flag.description: Specify hemisphere processing (e.g., lh for left hemisphere or rh for right hemisphere)
hemi_flag.title: Hemisphere Process Flag

expert_prefs_file.description: Read-in expert options file for processing. Overrides default options.
expert_prefs_file.title: Expert Preferences File

watershed_cmd.description: Controls how the skull stripping will be performed.
watershed_cmd.title: Watershed Command

xmask_file.description: Custom external brain mask to replace automated skullstripping.
xmask_file.title: External Brain Mask

wsless.description: Decrease watershed threshold (leaves less skull, but can strip more brain).
wsless.title: WSLess Flag

wsmore.description: Increase watershed threshold (leaves more skull, but can strip less brain).
wsmore.title: WSMore Flag

no_wsatlas.description: Do not use atlas when skull stripping.
no_wsatlas.title: No WSAtlas Flag

no_wsgcaatlas.description: Do not use GCA atlas when skull stripping.
no_wsgcaatlas.title: No WSGCAAtlas Flag

wsseed.description: Specify an index (C, R, S) point in the skull.
wsseed.title: WS Seed Point

normmaxgrad.description: Max grad (-g) for mri_normalize. Default is 1.
normmaxgrad.title: Norm Max Grad

norm1_b.description: In the first usage of mri_normalize, use control point with intensity N below target (default=10.0).
norm1_b.title: Norm1 B

norm2_b.description: In the second usage of mri_normalize, use control point with intensity N below target (default=10.0).
norm2_b.title: Norm2 B

norm1_n.description: In the first usage of mri_normalize, do N number of iterations.
norm1_n.title: Norm1 N

norm2_n.description: In the second usage of mri_normalize, do N number of iterations.
norm2_n.title: Norm2 N

cm_flag.description: Conform volumes to the min voxel size.
cm_flag.title: Conform Volumes Flag

no_fix_with_ga.description: Do not use genetic algorithm when fixing topology.
no_fix_with_ga.title: No Fix with GA Flag

fix_diag_only.description: Topology fixer runs until ?h.defect_labels files are created, then stops.
fix_diag_only.title: Fix Diag Only Flag

seg_wlo.description: Set wlo value for mri_segment and mris_make_surfaces.
seg_wlo.title: Segment WLO

seg_ghi.description: Set ghi value for mri_segment and mris_make_surfaces.
seg_ghi.title: Segment GHI

mprage.description: Assume scan parameters are MGH MP-RAGE protocol.
mprage.title: MPRAGE Protocol Flag

washu_mprage.description: Assume scan parameters are Wash.U. MP-RAGE protocol.
washu_mprage.title: WashU MPRAGE Flag

schwartzya3t_atlas.description: For tal reg, use special young adult 3T atlas.
schwartzya3t_atlas.title: Schwartzya 3T Atlas Flag

threads.description: Set number of threads to use.
threads.title: Number of Threads
